observation: dynamic reinspection v0.4 always ranks metabolic_contamination above source_quality and generic contested branches. Because repeated metabolic contest returns a terminal HOLD/quarantine without mutating the underlying contested branch, repeated scheduler passes can keep selecting the same quarantined branch and prevent other runnable contested branches from progressing.
risk: A correctly contained toxic or irreducibly contested branch can become a global scheduling sink. This converts quarantine from local containment into cross-branch starvation and makes the organism appear safely cautious while silently blocking unrelated metabolism.
requiredFix: Treat repeated metabolic contest as locally quarantined but non-runnable when other contested work exists. Preserve the quarantined branch and provenance, but allow the highest-priority runnable source_quality or generic contested branch to become nextInspection. If quarantine is the only contested work, retain HOLD/quarantine exactly as before.
promotionGate: Add adversarial mixed-branch tests proving a lone metabolic contest still HOLDs, a quarantined metabolic branch cannot starve runnable source_quality/generic branches, source_quality still outranks generic runnable work, stable tie ordering is preserved, and existing receipt/provenance regression remains intact. Require focused VAJRA and full integration CI success before closing evidence or promoting displayed state.
